flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login then Enter {{global.account1_email}} in the Email field.
Enter {{secrets.user.account1_password}} in the Password field.
Click 'Log in'.

Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/patients/new then Enter 'Maria Lopez' in the Full name field.
Leave Phone, Date of birth, Diagnosis and Notes empty.
Click 'Add patient'.
Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'.
Verify that the page shows the patient 'Maria Lopez' and no red error message.
